title: Someone You Were
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: A slow-burn garage-pop piece built around a warm, bittersweet piano chord progression that gradually unfolds over soft 2-step LinnDrum patterns and glassy casio textures. The track breathes through a long emotional arc — intimate and sparse at first, swelling into a euphoric middle with layered bass and shimmering hats, then dissolving back into just piano and room. Fred Again's intimate chord-led warmth meets the offbeat swing of Joy Orbison.
